self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Fangs Flying To and Fro: For 10s after using an Elemental Skill, Max HP is increased by 40% (additional +24% per Hydro character in party, up to +48%, not modeled here as it is team-comp dependent).

en.flavor: A boomerang made from the fangs of a giant sea serpent. It was a rare weapon indeed that the giant Tupac would call "trusty."

refinements.1: Decreases Swimming Stamina consumption by 15%. In addition, for 10s after using an Elemental Skill, Max HP is increased by <r>20%</r>. For every Hydro Elemental Type character in the party, Max HP is increased by another <r>12%</r>, and the maximum increase that can be achieved in this way is <r>24%</r>. Can be triggered once every 15s.

fr.flavor: Un boomerang fabriqué à partir des crocs d'un serpent de mer géant. C'est une arme rare que le géant Tupac qualifierait de « fidèle ».
